metric.name: gmv_last_month
metric.query: What was Wish's total GMV last month?
metric.notes: Line/variation-grain transaction facts. fct_daily_buyer and dau_attribution are user-day rollups the catalog also maps to GMV.

metric.name: refund_amount_last_week
metric.query: What was the total refunded amount on Wish orders last week?

metric.name: active_buyers_by_lifecycle
metric.query: Show ULC active buyers per day this month, split by lifecycle stage (new / retained / reactivated).

metric.name: add_to_cart_by_page
metric.query: How many add-to-cart events happened yesterday, broken down by page?

metric.name: wishpost_monthly_profit
metric.query: What was WishPost's monthly logistics profit over the past year?

metric.name: units_sold_last_month
metric.query: How many item units did buyers purchase on Wish last month?

metric.name: orders_yesterday
metric.query: How many orders (checkouts) were placed on Wish yesterday?
metric.notes: fct_daily_buyer added in review (2026-11-18): its per-buyer-day transaction count sums to total checkouts.

metric.name: buyers_last_week
metric.query: How many distinct buyers purchased something on Wish last week?

metric.name: atv_last_month
metric.query: What was the average transaction value (GMV per order) last month?

metric.name: take_rate_quarter
metric.query: What is our take rate, platform revenue as a share of GMV, this quarter?

metric.name: platform_revenue_last_month
metric.query: How much platform revenue (raw revenue after attributed costs) did Wish make last month?

metric.name: feed_tile_ctr
metric.query: What was the click-through rate of product tiles in the feed yesterday?

metric.name: impressions_per_product
metric.query: How many impressions did each product get yesterday?

metric.name: buyer_conversion_rate
metric.query: What share of daily active users made a purchase yesterday?

metric.name: average_star_rating
metric.query: What average star rating did customers give products last week?

metric.name: low_star_rating_share
metric.query: What share of product ratings submitted last month were 1 or 2 stars?

metric.name: shipment_delivery_rate
metric.query: What share of confirmed shipments were delivered last month?

metric.name: days_to_delivery
metric.query: On average, how many days did delivered parcels take from shipment to delivery last month?

metric.name: inventory_on_hand
metric.query: How much inventory is currently on hand across all products?

metric.name: new_user_registrations
metric.query: How many new users registered each day last week?

metric.name: total_registered_users
metric.query: How many registered users does Wish have in total?

metric.name: usd_eur_exchange_rate
metric.query: What USD to EUR exchange rate should I use for last month's reporting?

metric.name: erp_api_error_rate
metric.query: What share of merchant ERP API calls returned errors yesterday?

metric.name: wishpost_logistics_sales
metric.query: What were WishPost's logistics sales (fee revenue) per month this year?

metric.name: first_mile_purchase_by_fee
metric.query: Break down WishPost's first-mile purchase costs by fee type (logistics, warehouse, hub, outbound) per month.

metric.name: last_mile_cost_per_parcel
metric.query: What is WishPost's average last-mile purchase cost per parcel?

metric.name: parcel_combine_ratio
metric.query: On average, how many pre-combination parcels are merged into one combined WishPost shipment?
metric.notes: finance_monthly_profits_1y was added in review: its avg_combination_ratio metric (pre_tracking_id_cnt / post_tracking_id_cnt) answers the question across all programs; the by_combine_ratio table covers the warehouse-combination programs only.

metric.name: refund_lag_days
metric.query: How many days on average does it take from purchase to refund completion?

metric.name: merchant_order_refund_rate
metric.query: What percentage of merchant orders were refunded last month?

metric.name: checkout_to_payment_lag
metric.query: How long does it take on average from checkout until payment is received?

metric.name: experiment_session_duration
metric.query: What is the total session duration per subject in a given A/B experiment?

metric.name: merchant_fulfillment_time
metric.query: What is the average fulfillment time across our merchants?

metric.name: merchant_ticket_response_time
metric.query: How quickly do merchants respond to customer support tickets on average?

metric.name: order_discount_amount
metric.query: How much promotional discount was given on orders last month?

metric.name: wish_cash_used
metric.query: How much Wish Cash did buyers use to pay for orders last month?

metric.name: sales_tax_charged
metric.query: How much sales tax was charged to buyers last month?

metric.name: product_boost_revenue
metric.query: How much Product Boost revenue did we earn yesterday?

metric.name: merchant_payouts
metric.query: How much did we pay out to merchants last month?

metric.name: wishpost_parcel_weight
metric.query: What was the total actual weight of WishPost first-mile parcels yesterday?

metric.name: warehouse_shipping_option_price
metric.query: What is the average listed price of warehouse shipping options by destination country?

metric.name: power_users_yesterday
metric.query: How many power users (active on 10 or more of the last 28 days) did we have yesterday?

lookalike.name: dau_yesterday_without_bots
lookalike.query: How many daily active users did Wish have yesterday, excluding bots?
lookalike.notes: fct_dau_w_bots is the look-alike that keeps bot traffic; ulc_active_users is lifecycle activity, not same-day DAU.

lookalike.name: dau_including_guests
lookalike.query: How many daily active users did we have yesterday including guest (logged-out) visitors?
lookalike.notes: fct_dau is registered users only; guests are only on fct_dau_w_bots.

lookalike.name: ulc_active_users_not_dau
lookalike.query: How many ULC-active users (lifecycle-active, not same-day DAU) were there yesterday?
lookalike.notes: fct_dau counts same-day activity, the trap here.

lookalike.name: gmv_including_ltd
lookalike.query: What was GMV last month including Limited Time Deal items?
lookalike.notes: Same tables as default GMV; the member (w_ltd) differs. fct_daily_buyer and dau_attribution exclude LTD upstream.

lookalike.name: merchant_accounts_pending
lookalike.query: How many merchant user accounts are pending approval?
lookalike.notes: Account grain; merchant-grain snapshots are the trap.

lookalike.name: merchants_pending
lookalike.query: How many merchants (stores) are pending approval?
lookalike.notes: Merchant grain; merchant_user (accounts) is the trap.

lookalike.name: enabled_skus_in_catalog
lookalike.query: How many enabled SKUs (product variations) are in the catalog today?
lookalike.notes: master_products is product grain, the trap.

lookalike.name: active_products_in_catalog
lookalike.query: How many products are active in the catalog?
lookalike.notes: master_product_variations is SKU grain, the trap.

lookalike.name: refund_line_items_count
lookalike.query: How many refund line items were created last week?

lookalike.name: orders_with_a_refund
lookalike.query: How many orders had at least one refund last month?
lookalike.notes: Has-refund-line recipe; state=REFUNDED tables count fully refunded checkouts only.

lookalike.name: atc_visitors_incl_guests
lookalike.query: How many distinct visitors, including guests, added something to cart yesterday?
lookalike.notes: fct_dau has a2c flags but registered users only.

lookalike.name: wishpost_distinct_tracking
lookalike.query: How many distinct WishPost first-mile tracking numbers were handled yesterday?
lookalike.notes: master_order_tracking_infos is marketplace order tracking, not WishPost first mile.

lookalike.name: buyer_paid_shipping
lookalike.query: How much shipping did buyers pay on their orders last month?
lookalike.notes: WishPost logistics sales and purchase cost are the traps.

lookalike.name: merchant_item_cogs
lookalike.query: What was the total merchant item cost (COGS) on orders last month?
lookalike.notes: WishPost logistics purchase cost is the trap.

entity.query: Which table has each merchant's country, state and account settings?

entity.query: Where can I find product listing attributes like product name, subcategory and adult or counterfeit flags?

entity.name: order_tracking_checkpoints
entity.query: Which table tells me the shipping provider and delivery status for each order tracking number?

entity.name: user_profile_table
entity.query: Which table has each user's registration date, country and verification status?

entity.name: erp_partner_call_log
entity.query: Which table logs merchants' ERP partner API calls?

entity.name: experiment_subject_metrics
entity.query: Where are per-subject A/B experiment metrics stored?

out_of_corpus.notes: ads.country_spend answers it but is not among the 39 models; with --rag-collection metric_catalog_models every arm should answer null.

out_of_corpus.name: support_ticket_volume

out_of_corpus.notes: commerce_merchant has merchant ticket response time, not ticket counts.

out_of_corpus.name: top_search_queries
out_of_corpus.query: What were the top 20 search queries typed by users yesterday?

out_of_corpus.name: push_notification_open_rate
out_of_corpus.query: What was the open rate of push notifications sent last week?

out_of_corpus.name: employee_headcount
out_of_corpus.query: How many employees does Wish have in each department?

out_of_corpus.name: app_page_load_latency
out_of_corpus.query: What was the p95 page load time of the Wish app yesterday?

out_of_corpus.name: product_boost_campaign_budget
out_of_corpus.query: What daily budgets did merchants set on their Product Boost campaigns?
out_of_corpus.notes: Product Boost revenue is in feed_tile_interactions_detail; campaign budgets are not in any of the 39 models.
